title: arthraxon rudis
intro: Arthraxon rudis, commonly known as 'false mangrove' or 'mangrove grass', is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of Arthraxon rudis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
